capabilities.why: Safety hooks execute pre-command inspection callbacks in the host supervisor before dispatching instructions to the guest kernel, enabling dynamic blocking of dangerous commands like rm -rf, unauthorized privilege escalation, and suspicious outbound payload execution.

Network policy enforces strict microVM egress rules by disabling outbound public internet connectivity or whitelisting specific security package mirrors, completely neutralizing prompt-injection exfiltration vectors and reverse shell callbacks.

Snapshots freeze the microVM CPU, memory, and filesystem state into an immutable baseline, allowing instant sub-second rollback after untrusted package detonation or mid-task crashes without spending 40+ seconds provisioning a new computer.
